build_lightconv_language_model: build a LightConvLanguageModel instance by calling build_model with args and task
register_lightconv_lm_model: register the lightconv_lm model architecture using the register_model decorator
configure_base_lm_architecture: configure default arguments for the base_lm_architecture including decoder dimensions and layers
configure_lightconv_lm_gbw_architecture: configure the lightconv_lm_gbw architecture with larger FFN dimensions and more attention heads
add_lightconv_lm_args: add model-specific CLI arguments like dropout and decoder dimensions to an argparse parser
